name: alerts_list
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/alerts/
alerts_list
Required: project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: created_by (query) — Optional. Restrict results to alerts created by the user with this UUID.; has_detector (query) — Optional. Restrict results by whether the alert uses anomaly detection.; insight_id (query) — Optional. Restrict results to alerts on this insight ID.; insight_tag (query) — Optional. Restrict results to alerts whose insight has this tag.; limit (query) — Number of results to return per page.; offset (query) — The initial index from which to return the results.; search (query) — Optional. Fuzzy match against alert `name` using Postgres trigram word similarity (handles typos, transpositions, and prefix-as-you-type). Results are ordered by relevance, then creation time. Capped at 200 characters; longer queries return a 400 error.

name: alerts_retrieve
context:
GET /api/projects/{project_id}/alerts/{id}/
alerts_retrieve
Required: id (path) — A UUID string identifying this alert configuration.; project_id (path) — Project ID of the project you're trying to access. To find the ID of the project, make a call to /api/projects/.
Optional: checks_date_from (query) — Relative date string for the start of the check history window (e.g. '-24h', '-7d', '-14d'). Returns checks created after this time. Max retention is 14 days.; checks_date_to (query) — Relative date string for the end of the check history window (e.g. '-1h', '-1d'). Defaults to now if not specified.; checks_limit (query) — Maximum number of check results to return (default 5, max 500). Applied after date filtering.; checks_offset (query) — Number of newest checks to skip (0-based). Use with checks_limit for pagination. Default 0.
